Verified ServerExtend.kt:46 boots Netty app with /events (SSE streaming) and /rpc (JSON POST) endpoints. RestPlayerConnectionManager.kt:23 and RestServerConnectionCoordinator.kt:8 exist with proper implementations. GeneratedGameRpcBindings.kt:1 contains RPC handler wiring calling GameRpcHandlers.
Verified ServerExtendHttpTest.kt:14 exists with testApplication usage, testing /player health check and /rpc validation for missing/unknown playerId as claimed.

No stubs, mocks, or fake implementations found in server-extend. GameRpcHandlers exists in server module with real implementations. Server and server-extend have nearly identical dependencies, confirming compatibility. REST API streaming is implemented via /events endpoint with SSE. RPC system uses same GameRpcHandlers as server module.
